name: Weihai Honglin Electronic Co., Ltd.
summary: Weihai Honglin Electronic Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of power cord components and special cables for use in 3C, household appliances, and channel markets in China and internationally. The company offers computer and household appliance, smart home, and access power cord assemblies; and precision electrical wiring, rubber wires, special cables for industrial equipment, and new energy electric vehicle charging connection products. It also engages in housing rental activities. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Weihai, China. Weihai Honglin Electronic Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Weihai Mingbo Cable…
